notes.title: Sunshine Love Chapter 3 Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

With Christmas just around the corner, we’d like to share some other great news with you all.

First off, we’d like to show our appreciation and give thanks to those of you who purchased Chapter 1 and/or 2 of Sunshine Love, and also bought our other games through our Patreon and/or Subscribestar pages. 

There has been a very positive response to Sunshine Love ever since we released the game on Steam 
and we’ll be looking to host our other games on there in the future.

Chapter 2 was released late last month, and now the final chapter (Chapter 3) will be available to download and play on December  25, at 8 p.m. (GMT-3).

And there will be a 40% discount from the date of release which will last for 14 days!

There will also be a download available where we have combined all 3 chapters into one app (Bundle).

To any Steam curators who would like to review any of our Steam games now, or in the future, you can contact us via our email or Discord.

And don’t forget to please “Wishlist” Chapter 3!

Here are the links:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3342550/Sunshine_Love_Chapter_3/?beta=0]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3342550/Sunshine_Love_Chapter_3/?beta=0[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3343050/Sunshine_Love_CH3_Walkthrough/?beta=0]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3343050/Sunshine_Love_CH3_Walkthrough/?beta=0[/url]

Thanks everyone, I’ll be in touch again very soon. 
MrDots.

notes.title: Sunshine Love Chapter 2 Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Today we have some exciting news. But first, we’d like to show our appreciation and give thanks 
to those of you who purchased Chapter 1 of Sunshine Love, and also bought our other games through 
our Patreon and/or Subscribestar pages. 

The response to SL being released on Steam has exceeded our expectations.

During the past month, we’ve been working hard on adapting Chapters 2 and 3, also to be released 
on Steam. We’ve been working on combining the content across all three chapters so that they can 
be played in one single game app instead of downloading multiple apps for each chapter.

Today we are very happy to announce that Chapter 2 will be officially released on Steam, 
on November 27th, at 8 p.m. (GMT-3).

And there will be a 30% discount from the date of release which will last for 7 days!

For Chapter 3, it is scheduled to be released in December at some point. 

So there’s not too long to wait to download and play each of these chapters.

To any Steam curators who would like to review any of our Steam games now, or in the future, you can contact us via our email or Discord.

And most importantly, please make sure to “Wishlist” Chapter 2!

Thanks everyone, I’ll be in touch again very soon. 
MrDots
